shortDescription: Module for setup of ApplicationProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: cloud_config_cksum
options.description: Checksum of application profiles. Internally set by cloud connector. Field introduced in 17.2.14, 18.1.5, 18.2.1.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Name of the application profile creator. Field introduced in 17.2.14, 18.1.5, 18.2.1.

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: dns_service_profile
options.description: Specifies various dns service related controls for virtual service.

options.name: dos_rl_profile
options.description: Specifies various security related controls for virtual service.

options.name: http_profile
options.description: Specifies the http application proxy profile parameters.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the application profile.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: preserve_client_ip
options.description: Specifies if client ip needs to be preserved for backend connection. Not compatible with connection multiplexing. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: preserve_client_port
options.description: Specifies if we need to preserve client port while preserving client ip for backend connections. Field introduced in 17.2.7. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: sip_service_profile
options.description: Specifies various sip service related controls for virtual service. Field introduced in 17.2.8, 18.1.3, 18.2.1.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tcp_app_profile
options.description: Specifies the tcp application proxy profile parameters.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies which application layer proxy is enabled for the virtual service. Enum options - APPLICATION_PROFILE_TYPE_L4, APPLICATION_PROFILE_TYPE_HTTP, APPLICATION_PROFILE_TYPE_SYSLOG, APPLICATION_PROFILE_TYPE_DNS, APPLICATION_PROFILE_TYPE_SSL, APPLICATION_PROFILE_TYPE_SIP.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the application profile.
